landing.hero_title_lead: We build you an AI employee
landing.hero_sub: Your business never misses a call again. The AI answers, books jobs, follows up with warm leads, and brings you a weekly summary — on autopilot, in your voice.
landing.preview_msg_1: Comfort Pros HVAC, this is Alex — how can I help?
landing.preview_msg_2: My AC isn't cooling and the house is 85°
landing.preview_msg_3: That's uncomfortable — I can get a tech out between 2–4pm today. What's the address?
landing.preview_msg_5: Booked. We'll text when the tech is 30 minutes out. Service call is $89 plus parts.
landing.preview_scored: Lead scored and sent to CRM
landing.pillars_title: An entire office in one place.
landing.pillar_receptionist_desc: Answers calls and texts 24/7, books appointments into your calendar, hands off to a human when needed. Trained on your services and prices.
landing.pillar_sales_desc: Every call auto-scored hot / warm / cold with the reason. Objection playbook. Discount guardrails. Follow-up cadence that never misses a warm lead.
landing.pillar_growth_desc: Weekly digest, review requests, win-back campaigns, referral tracking, service-area heatmap, and a one-line website widget — all running without you.
landing.industries_sub: The AI adapts to your industry out of the box — jargon, service names, pricing patterns, intake flow.
landing.industry_hvac_example: Service calls, emergency dispatch, maintenance plans
landing.industry_dental_example: New-patient intake, insurance checks, hygiene reminders
landing.industry_salon_example: Stylist booking, service questions, walk-in handling
landing.faq_1_a: No. It replaces the voicemail and the missed-call black hole. Think of it as the receptionist you can afford to have 24/7 — human staff still handle on-site work and the calls the AI escalates.
landing.faq_2_q: What happens if the AI messes up?
landing.faq_2_a: Three layers of safety: it never makes commitments outside your knowledge base, every call is transcribed so you can audit, and you set guardrails (discount caps, objection script, persona depth). You can also take over any live call from the dashboard.
landing.faq_3_a: Yes. Monthly plans — cancel in-app, access runs through the end of the paid period. No calls to a rep, no retention tricks.
landing.faq_4_a: Multi-tenant isolation on day one. We don't sell data. Export or delete anything on request. Full privacy policy linked below.
landing.faq_5_q: Do I need a Twilio account?
landing.faq_5_a: No — you can bring your own, or we provision a number for you inside your workspace. Either works.
landing.faq_6_a: Primarily English today. Other languages are coming — join the waitlist and tell us which.
landing.waitlist_sub: We'll send a short note when seats open in your industry — and we'll never spam you.
landing.waitlist_success_sub: We'll reach out as soon as your industry opens.
landing.waitlist_note_ph: Anything specific you'd want it to do?
landing.footer_tagline: Done-for-you AI office platform for service businesses.
